config_file_text:
paths:
  output_dir: "/data2/jt577/2026/08.2026/blob_EAT/08.28/out_MgB2H8_H_sublattice_GEAT_GA_08.27.26_discrete_FIRE_tournament"
  import_structures_json: ""

model:
  # Leave blank to use MP_API_KEY from the environment.
  mp_api_key: ""
  model_name: "uma-s-1p1"
  task_name: "omat"
  # GPU is required. The script disables the optional Triton bmm override,
  # matching the working dislocation benchmark, so CUDA remains usable even
  # when Triton cannot compile cuda_utils.c due to a missing Python.h header.
  device: "cuda"

crystal:
  # Leave ground_truth_file blank to use Materials Project (the legacy path).
  # When set, use an experimental periodic CIF or XSF instead; its CIF
  # symmetry is expanded by ASE, then the complete structure is relaxed with
  # FAIRChem before the variable H sublattice is removed. Relative paths are
  # resolved relative to this YAML file. The MP API is still used for the
  # elemental reference energies in the formation-energy objective.
  ground_truth_file: "/data2/jt577/2026/07.2026/blob_EAT/07.19/MgB2H8_experimental_structure/cm803019e_si_003.cif"
  # If ground_truth_file is blank and material_id is blank, the lowest-energy-
  # hull exact-formula MP match is used.
  # When ground_truth_file is nonempty, material_id/material_formula are only
  # descriptive; set species to every element present in that file.
  material_id: ""
  material_formula: "MgB2H8"
  species: "Mg, B, H"
  variable_species: "H"
  # This is the MgB2H8 placement supercell, not an EAT hole size.
  supercell: "1, 1, 1"
  # The base-cell feasible grid is searched once and then tiled into the supercell.
  feasible_grid: "16, 16, 48"
  feasible_min_distance_angstrom: 1.0
  initial_h_h_min_distance_angstrom: 1.0
  pbc: "true, true, true"

ground_truth_relaxation:
  fmax: 0.05
  steps: 200
  maxstep: 0.10
  relax_cell: true
  # Unit-cell relaxation is always performed first. Set true to additionally
  # relax the repeated supercell before the H sublattice is removed.
  relax_supercell: false

initialization:
  # "eat" uses the legacy fractional EAT reservoir. "discrete" uses the
  # ordinary-GA hard initialization: exactly the known missing-H count,
  # one-hot unit occupancies, and the same minimum-distance repair. This
  # setting controls generation 0 and every later random immigrant.
  random_member_initialization: "discrete"
  discrete_count_min: 1
  # Unused in fixed-count H mode; kept equal to the ordinary-GA YAML.
  discrete_count_max_factor: 1.0
  discrete_repair_attempts: 2000
  # The relaxed-GT H count sets the initial candidate count and the minimum
  # candidate-site reservoir, not an upper cap on realized H atoms. Crossover
  # keeps every active site; if fewer total candidates remain than this floor,
  # zero-occupancy H candidates are sampled from the feasible grid.
  null_density_per_angstrom3: 0.15
  subcell_grid: "4, 4, 16"
  init_occ_total: 1.0
  init_occ_noise: 0.05
  init_species_dirichlet_alpha: 5.0
  init_position_mode: "feasible_grid"
  init_position_jitter_angstrom: 0.15
  keep_thresh: 0.001
  seed: 76348

objective:
  # Soft composition matching keeps the Mg:B:H target visible to EAT.
  composition_penalty: 5.0
  # The H search is the full periodic cell, so no boundary penalty is used.
  hole_boundary_penalty: 0.0
  hole_boundary_margin_angstrom: 0.0
  # Deliberately disabled: the requested benchmark uses composition/energy,
  # without an imposed minimum-occupancy term.
  occupancy_lower_bound_enable: false
  occupancy_lower_bound_gamma: 0.7
  occupancy_lower_bound_penalty: 0.05
  occupancy_lower_bound_softplus_sharpness: 1.0

candidate_relaxation:
  # Applied after syntropization and hard rounding, before GA scoring.
  # The cell and all scaffold atoms remain fixed.
  enable: true
  fmax: 0.05
  steps: 500
  maxstep_angstrom: 0.10
  unconverged_penalty: 0.0

syntropization:
  tsallis_q: 2.0
  beta0: 0.001
  beta_mult: 1.5
  beta_max_stages: 0
  entropy_stop_avg: 0.0001
  binary_stop_maxmin: 0.001
  also_require_binary_stop: false

minimizer:
  maxit: 50
  tol: 0.005
  bfgs_hist: 10
  max_line_search: 3

history:
  disable_trajectory_history: true
  history_every: 1

genetic:
  enable: true
  population_size: 30
  generations: 100
  elite_fraction: 0.20
  crossover_fraction: 0.70
  random_fraction: 0.10
  parent_pool_size: 30
  import_parent_count: 0
  parent_a_tournament_size: 3
  superposition_occ_scale: 0.5
  superposition_prune_distance_angstrom: 1.0
  superposition_prune_occ_thresh: 0.001
  crossover_pos_sigma: 0.20
  crossover_occ_sigma: 0.05
  crossover_species_sigma: 0.0
  live_plot_enable: true
  live_plot_file: ""
  live_plot_metric: "score"
  live_plot_alpha: 0.45
  live_plot_jitter: 0.16
  parallel_workers: 2
  parallel_gpu_ids: "0,1"
  execution_backend: "local"
  log_file: ""

runtime:
  terminal_verbose: true
  heartbeat_interval_seconds: 100.0
  running_log_file: ""
